hero.title: Mechanical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Master’s in Mechanical Engineering is a postgraduate qualification for students interested in advanced mechanical systems, machine design, manufacturing, thermal engineering, energy systems and industrial technology. It can help graduates deepen their engineering knowledge and prepare for specialist technical or research-oriented careers. For Indian applicants exploring a **Master’s in Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students**, comparing available postgraduate programmes and their specialisations is an important first step.

overview: Important course availability note: The University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate programme list for 2026–2027 does not list a dedicated MSc or Master’s in Mechanical Engineering. It offers related programmes, including MSc Building Services Engineering, MSc Sustainable Energy Engineering with Environmental Management, and MSc Total Quality Management and Performance Excellence. These are related options, not equivalent qualifications in Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Is a Master’s in Mechanical Engineering available in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A dedicated Master’s in Mechanical Engineering was not found in the University of Mauritius’s published postgraduate programme list for 2026–2027. Related options include Building Services Engineering and Sustainable Energy Engineering with Environmental Management.

faq.question: Which university offers related postgraduate engineering courses?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius lists postgraduate programmes in Building Services Engineering, Sustainable Energy Engineering with Environmental Management, Renewable Energy and Smart Electrical Systems, and other engineering-related areas. Contact the university to confirm which options fit your academic background.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: A verified tuition fee for a dedicated Mechanical Engineering master’s is not available because the programme has not been confirmed. Indicative living expenses are estimated at MUR 15,000–25,000 per month, or approximately ₹28,500–₹47,500 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. Tuition and other expenses are additional.

faq.question: What qualifications are required for postgraduate engineering study?
faq.answer: Applicants generally need a recognised bachelor’s degree in an appropriate discipline and must meet the programme’s academic requirements. The specific subject background and grades required depend on the chosen course.

faq.question: What careers can I pursue after a Mechanical Engineering master’s?
faq.answer: Depending on your qualification and experience, potential careers include mechanical design engineer, manufacturing engineer, energy engineer, building services engineer, quality engineer and research and development engineer.
